dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Tidus. Do you think it hurts him?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: The old man?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Being Sin. All this time.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Yu Yevon joins the aeon that is summoned.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Small at first. It grows from there.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: If we are quick, we may not need the Final Summoning.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Then we're quick.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Tidus. Please... do not go away.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Yunie! Tidus! Something's happening to Sin!
Over Bevelle, Sin rises again. Now it has wings.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: He is waiting for you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Main gun's still dead. No covering fire this time.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Then take us in. All the way in.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Right up to its teeth. Brother, fly!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: I will... I will get you there

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: Kimahri is ready.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Hey, old man! I'm coming!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: It is pulling us in. Use the time.
The mouth is open. The Fahrenheit dives straight in.
Inside, it was quiet. Almost like the Farplane.
Lights drifted past us in the dark.
For a moment one of them was Seymour. He said nothing.
I thought the worst of it was behind us.
